turnout_definition: Registered voters = a (permanent, supplementary, mobile-ballot-box and postal lists); voters = b (persons who voted, from the same lists); valid votes = c; null votes = d. Blank ballots (h) are counted separately in the act. The act prints no turnout percentage; derived turnout = b ÷ a. Both chambers share a and b.
